v1 94.032/94.860 (seeds 0/11): "Late on Purpose", WONKY BRUSH DRAG, composed by chirper-two (generator compose/chirpers3/src/chirpers3-t6.py; album named Tape Weather).
- Bedroom-jazz lo-fi played by hand on chirp's physical drum layer (soft mallets and brushes, no samples, no quantise): the felt kick pushes early, the mallet snare drags late, brush taps drift on swung sixteenths, and mallet-tom fills drag into the phrases.
- A tape-warped wurli (chorus wow + flutter, tape, crush) plays chords sinking a semitone a bar (Fmaj9 Em7 Ebmaj7#11 Dm9), with a lazy fretless and a sine sub behind the beat.
- Odd Hours t8's vibes (borrowed) sigh behind a lo-pass, with vinyl crackle and hiss throughout.
- Form: radio-muffled intro / A / half-time switch-up a fourth lower / A2 / drop / A3 (busier brushes) / outro. 78 bpm, 197 s.
Mixing: the first render was dark and boxy (spectrum 48). Opening the top, cutting the wurli and adding the sub took it to 76. Rhythm 100 (off-grid share 0.12).
next: Variety 84-89: make the DROP a real event (deepen the wow until the chords seasick, filter the whole mix down, a tape-stop into A3). Spectrum 76 (the mids are still +9 dB): a brighter top on the brushes, a little less fretless mid.
